briefing.summary: As of Saturday August 8, 12:00 AM, the Bald Range wildfire near Summerland, British Columbia has been tracked for 7.2 hours with 95 satellite fire detections. There are 24 road segments likely affected, including Bathville Road, Princeton-Summerland Road, Garnet Valley Road, and Marsh Lane. An estimated 60 residents are cut off under both distance rules. An evacuation order for the entire District of Summerland was issued just after this snapshot, shortly after midnight on August 8, 2026, as reported by CBC.
steps: Stay informed through official local channels and monitor updates from the BC Wildfire Service and EmergencyInfoBC
Review local evacuation orders and follow instructions from local authorities
Keep vehicles fueled and ready in case travel is necessary
what_to_bring: Water, non-perishable food, and basic clothing
pets: Ensure pets have secure carriers, leashes, and collars with current ID
Pack enough food, water, and necessary medications for your animals
caveats: These are illustrative estimates from public data including satellite fire detections, OpenStreetMap roads, and modelled population, not official guidance
Drive times are estimated minimums with no congestion, showing an average sample of 14.1 minutes and a longest sample of 21.2 minutes from 74 sample points in Summerland
Rely on the BC Wildfire Service, EmergencyInfoBC, and local evacuation orders for real decisions and official instructions
